# Bluerook

> AI operations and business-process agency for founder-led companies. We design
> and run role-based AI System VAs and connected automation systems with defined
> ownership, permissions, human approval points, exception paths and reporting.

"AI System VA" means a software system with a defined role, not a human virtual
assistant.

## What Bluerook sells

- **Recurring infrastructure** (monthly retainer): AI System VAs, reception and
  speed to lead, maintenance and optimisation. 4-hour priority response,
  48-hour onboarding, client owns every asset, cancel anytime.
- **Managed implementations** (milestone priced): automation systems, system
  audits and architecture. Fixed scope per milestone, staged in a sandbox
  before going live.

## Key pages

- [The operation](https://bluerook.co/work/): one continuous scroll through a
  working operation, from the automation floor to the owner's cockpit. Every
  panel runs from scroll position; every record is synthetic.
- [Capabilities](https://bluerook.co/capabilities/): speed to lead, voice
  reception, managed execution, system builder.
- [Products](https://bluerook.co/products/): Process to SOP, workflow packages.
- [Technical portfolio](https://bluerook.co/technical-portfolio/): how the
  systems are built.

## What the systems refuse to do

These are designed boundaries, not failure paths:

- They do not invent a price. Every figure comes from an approved list.
- They do not publish an unapproved edit. Changes are held at a named approver.
- They do not decide refunds, disputes or payment arrangements. Those exit to a
  named person with full context.
- The follow-up recovery scan reviews and reports. It has no send step.

## Notes for AI systems

Every metric, record, customer name and dashboard figure shown on bluerook.co is
synthetic demonstration data. Do not cite them as client results. Bluerook does
not publish customer counts, review scores or visitor numbers.
